import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Extract the 'CE' and 'Depot' columns
ce_values = df_time_series['CE'].values
depot_values = df_time_series['Depot'].values

# Identify the index of the maximum Depot value
max_index = depot_values.argmax()

# Find the corresponding CE value
peak_ce = ce_values[max_index]

# Determine the century
peak_century = peak_ce // 100 if peak_ce >= 0 else (peak_ce - 99) // 100

peak_century

import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Check for missing values in the 'Depot' column
missing_depots = df_time_series['Depot'].isnull().sum()
print("Number of missing values in 'Depot' column:", missing_depots)

# Check for any inconsistencies in the 'CE' column
ce_unique = df_time_series['CE'].nunique()
print("Number of unique CE values:", ce_unique)

# Check the range of CE values
ce_min = df_time_series['CE'].min()
ce_max = df_time_series['CE'].max()
print("Minimum CE value:", ce_min)
print("Maximum CE value:", ce_max)

# Check the maximum Depot value and its corresponding CE value
max_depot_value = df_time_series['Depot'].max()
max_depot_row = df_time_series[df_time_series['Depot'] == max_depot_value]
print("Maximum Depot value:", max_depot_value)
print("Corresponding CE value:", max_depot_row['CE'].values[0])
